frequency_question: How often do threatened indefinite industry-wide strikes by major labor union coalitions actually result in the commencement of the strike within the threatened timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes formalized industry-wide strike notices or call-to-actions by multi-union coalitions in national banking or public utility sectors. Excludes single-employer strikes or wildcat strikes without central federation backing.
window: Within 30 days of a strike notice or deadline

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU call (2022)

coverage_note: 6 named representative instances of major banking federation strike threats in the jurisdiction; believed roughly 8-10 in total over the last decade.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional or single-bank actions; focuses exclusively on national federation-level coalition threats.
validity_reason: Labor relations frameworks and union negotiation tactics evolve slowly over multi-year cycles.
